subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat can render assistant reply before user prompt and duplicate inbound messages

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the concrete WebChat tracker until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80670 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101494 are resolved, or fold the remaining evidence into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/69208?
rationale: The issue is credible and current main is not proven fixed, but the evidence now spans two open PRs and a broader duplicate transcript umbrella rather than one safe autonomous repair path.

options.title: Keep Standalone Until PRs Resolve
options.body: Keep this issue open as the concrete WebChat report and close it only after the relevant PRs land or maintainers prove the symptom belongs solely to another tracker.

options.title: Fold Into The Umbrella
options.body: Close this as a duplicate only if maintainers decide the unique WebChat report adds no separate tracking value beyond the broader duplicate transcript umbrella.

options.title: Queue A Fresh Fix
options.body: Start a new repair only if the existing PRs are rejected and maintainers identify one narrow owner boundary with a reproducible current-main failure.

recommendation.title: Keep Standalone Until PRs Resolve
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the concrete WebChat report and close it only after the relevant PRs land or maintainers prove the symptom belongs solely to another tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent WebChat reconciliation and current-main area work makes them the best routing candidate for deciding tracker ownership versus PR resolution.
